messages:
Maya: Quick sync — proposing an upgrade phasing plan for Private deployments (VPC + on‑prem). Goal is to reduce customer downtime and limit migration risk while shipping critical netops features. Sketch below, want feedback on risks and launch criteria.

Maya: Phase A: packaging + installer stability (no schema changes). Deliverables: airgap-enabled installer, improved logs, 1-click retry for handshake. Target: internal beta with two current customers.

Maya: Phase B: lightweight config migration (rolling handshake). Deliverables: handshake v2 (backwards compatible), IP whitelisting, optional routing proxy. Target: staged rollouts with dedicated capacity.

Maya: Phase C: opt-in protocol upgrade (breaking, but higher perf). Deliverables: new routing protocol, canary + auto-fallback, migration tooling. Target: opt-in for customers after verification.

Raj (eng-runtime): +1 on phasing. Concern: Phase B rolling handshake needs KV cache compatibility in runtime. If we don't preserve old KV layout we risk tail latencies during migration.

Linh (eng-infra): Noted. We'll need a compatibility shim for at least 48h. Also need to validate autoscaler behavior during handoffs. Can run a load test sim that mirrors current seq-lens.

Nora (solutions): From field: customers want clear rollback windows and a 'no-change' option for critical environments. They also ask that we document required firewall/NAT changes per phase.

Sam (customer-success): Two customers already asked for IP whitelisting + offline agent before GA. If Phase A doesn't include basic whitelists, we lose booking for Q3 pilots.

Diego (security): Any plan must include KMS key rotation guidance and audit log retention per phase. Phase B introduces routing changes that will need threat-model review. Please tag sec review in PRs.

Maya: Action items from this thread:
- Eng: prototype KV compatibility shim and load test (Raj / Linh) — due EOW.
- Solutions: draft rollback/comms template + firewall checklist (Nora / Sam) — due Tue.
- Security: schedule threat review for Phase B (Diego) — please confirm availability.

Raj (eng-runtime): putting a short runbook in this thread. Example handshake-check command:
```
# verify handshake
redwoodctl handshake --env prod --verify --timeout 120s
```
Will add metrics hooks: handshake_success_rate, handshake_latency.

ops-bot: Note: staging rollout scheduled for 2026-05-12 18:00 UTC (automated canary window enabled).

Linh (eng-infra): For load test, I'll seed with 3 customer profiles (low/med/high) and include long-prefix cache hits. Attaching perf targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for Phase A.

Nora (solutions): We'll confirm with pilot customers whether they want Phase A only or B staged. Also collecting failure-mode expectations (max tolerable downtime 5m / planned migration windows).

Sam (customer-success): I'll surface these constraints to the pilots and gather network diagrams.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If no major objections by EOD Friday we'll lock priors and begin prototypes. Ping me directly for tradeoff debates. :thumbsup:
